title: Implement incremental refresh: staleness, re-ingest, prune
description:
**Files:** `src/store/ingest.rs`, `tests/steps/store_steps.rs`.

**Specs turned green:** `06_refresh.feature` — remove its @wip.

**Acceptance:** `Store::refresh(&adapters) -> IngestReport`: staleness by (id, last_activity_at, message_count) from summaries — unchanged means no adapter open; new or changed means open + `content_hash` compare + re-ingest in one transaction when actually changed (delete + reinsert message/part/FTS/embedding rows); prune sessions an adapter no longer reports; report counts per outcome (new / updated / unchanged / pruned).

Gates: cargo fmt --all; cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings; RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc --no-deps; cargo test and cargo test --test bdd. All existing suites stay green (features/01_structure, features/03_importers, features/04_examples, features/cli).
